summary: Iteration 2 focused on validating the CRITICAL fixes from iteration 1 + new language toggle. RESULT: All previously broken flows now work. Zero pageerrors / zero console.error throughout the entire flow. AI (btnAiAsk), Auditoría (btnAudit), Restaurar còpia (btnImportJson), Historial (btnHistory), Llibreta (btnLedger) and Estadístiques (cStats) modals now open correctly — the 'Cannot set properties of null (setting onclick)' bug is FIXED. New 🌐 Language toggle works CA↔ES and translates all data-i18n texts + placeholders. Bicompany switcher, add Trafic/Priv/DH entries, persistence F5, snapshots, ledger with balance-per-account all work. Found ONE regression bug caused by the new i18n implementation: the '🗑️ Vaciar día' button (#btnClearDay) is nested inside a <h2 data-i18n='entries_of_day'>, and applyLang() overwrites the h2 with textContent, deleting the child button from DOM on every language change (and on initial load, since applyLang runs at startup).

critical_code_review_comments: applyLang() uses el.textContent = dict[k] which is destructive to child elements. Any [data-i18n] element that also contains DOM children (buttons, icons, badges) will lose those children on every language switch and on initial load. This is a systemic risk — audit ALL data-i18n usages for nested children. Current victim: h2.entries_of_day → #btnClearDay.
Suggested robust fix: iterate only over elements where el.children.length === 0 in applyLang(), or use a dedicated <span data-i18n='…'> child element for each translatable text.
The file is now 1090+ lines — still exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules.
All previous critical review points from iteration 1 (AI/Audit modal null onclick) are RESOLVED — no more null-onclick errors detected across 6 modal open/close cycles.

rca_of_the_issue: btnClearDay missing from DOM. Reproduction: fresh load → check document.getElementById('btnClearDay') → returns null. Root cause: applyLang() runs on startup (line 1088-1090 area) and iterates all [data-i18n] elements, doing el.textContent = translation. Line 228 places the button as a CHILD of a <h2 data-i18n='entries_of_day'>, so its textContent assignment deletes the button. Confirmed via grep: the button IS in the source HTML (line 228) and has a valid onclick handler (line 789), but the runtime DOM shows it removed. Mitigation: move data-i18n to a text-only inner <span>.
